A companion on Wi-Fi, or a USB radio relayed by a computer (lichen bridge; the Android emulator reaches it at 10.0.2.2:5000). The network link to the radio is not encrypted: on a shared network, someone can read and change MeshCore chats, contacts and channels. lichen messages stay end-to-end encrypted.
